name: Agent CA Election Amendment Request V 01
definition: Scope|This message is sent by a CSD to the issuer (or its agent) to request the authorisation of an amendment of a previously sent Agent Corporate Action Election Advice message.|Usage|This message is used to request the amendment of a previously sent Agent Corporate Action Election Advice message.|Once the amendment request has been accepted by the issuer (or its agent), the CSD will process any resource movement and send an Agent Corporate Action Election Advice message with the function, option change, to confirm that the amendment has been booked at the CSD.|This message is used when the terms and conditions of the corporate action event allow amendments.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification assigned by the Sender to unambiguously identify the request.

AgentCAElectionAdviceIdentification.name: Agent CA Election Advice Identification
AgentCAElectionAdviceIdentification.definition: Identification of the linked Agent CA Election Advice for which an amendment is requested.

CorporateActionGeneralInformation.name: Corporate Action General Information
CorporateActionGeneralInformation.definition: General information about the corporate action event.

OriginalElectionDetails.name: Original Election Details
OriginalElectionDetails.definition: Provides information about the original election to be amended.

AmendedElectionDetails.name: Amended Election Details
AmendedElectionDetails.definition: Provides information about the amendments to the election.

ContactDetails.name: Contact Details
ContactDetails.definition: Contact responsible for the transaction identified in the message.
